description: You can follow a supplied loop tree from instruction generation to stack-based execution.

steps.description: The setup defines opcodes, instruction chunks, and tree nodes. The binary-operation table connects arithmetic syntax to VM operations.
Compiler emits instructions for values and statements. The while case records its condition position, emits a backward jump, and patches the exit target.
Function-related compiler cases create chunks and call instructions. CallFrame stores a chunk's current instruction position and locals.
The VM fetches instructions from the current frame. Its arithmetic handlers pop operands and push results.
